story: No false alarm, in English: a real renovation with a consistent story is not paused.

steps.caption: A real renovation this time. Same customer, same transfer of ¥3,000,000, same flagged payee.
The teller keys in the transfer. Before any money moves, the bank's rules check where it is going.
She presses Submit. Before any money moves, the bank's rules check where it is going.
The payee account is 4 days old, and 7 different people have paid it this week. That is enough to raise an alert.
Elevated. The money is held for now and the teller sees the reasons. This is a reason to ask a question, not an accusation.
The customer speaks English, so the teller sets the conversation language to English before the first turn.
The copilot suggests an approved question. The teller taps Say this and asks it.
Now a genuine case. The customer says she has met the builder several times and has a written quote.

do.text: I've met the builder several times since last month, and I have their written quote.

steps.caption: The band stays below High. A flagged account alone never pauses a customer who gives a consistent story.

do.message: the band reached High for the genuine renovation story

steps.caption: The teller carries on normally. No pause, no delay. The tool did not get in the way of a real customer.
